lines.original: When forty winters shall besiege thy brow
lines.english: When forty winters will occupy your forehead,

lines.original: And dig deep trenches in thy beauty’s field,
lines.english: And dig deep trenches the field that beauty now occupies,
lines.translation: Ve derin çukurlar yarınca şimdi güzelliğin hükmü olan o diyara,

lines.original: Thy youth’s proud livery, so gazed on now,
lines.english: The proud clothing of your youth, so admired by others now,
lines.translation: Üstünde taşıdığın ve herkesin hayran olduğu o gençlik elbisen,

lines.original: Will be a tattered weed, of small worth held.
lines.english: Will be ripped rags, considered to be worth little.

lines.original: Then being asked where all thy beauty lies,
lines.english: Then when someone asks you where all your beauty is,
lines.translation: Sonra biri sorarsa sana nerede kaldı tüm bu güzellik,

lines.original: Where all the treasure of thy lusty days,
lines.english: Where all the treasure of your sexually active days lies,
lines.translation: Nerede o şehvetli günlerinin definesi diye,

lines.original: To say within thine own deep-sunken eyes
lines.english: To say that it lies within your own deep-sunken eyes,
lines.translation: Çökmüş gözlerinin içinde saklı olduğunu söylemek,

lines.original: Were an all-eating shame and thriftless praise.
lines.english: Would be an all-consuming shame and wasteful of praise.
lines.translation: Büsbütün ayıp ve tüm o övgülerin israfı olacak.

lines.original: How much more praise deserved thy beauty’s use
lines.english: The use of your beauty would deserve so much more praise
lines.translation: Ah daha ne övgüler yağardı bu güzelliğin tasarrufuna,

lines.original: If thou couldst answer, “This fair child of mine
lines.english: If you could answer:  'This beautiful child of mine

lines.original: Shall sum my count and make my old excuse,”
lines.english: Is the receipt of my beauty and the excuse for my oldness.'

lines.original: Proving his beauty by succession thine.
lines.english: And his beauty will be proved because he is your son.
lines.translation: Onun güzelliğinin ispatı ise olurdu senden olması.

lines.original: This were to be new made when thou art old,
lines.english: This child would be youthful when you are old,
lines.translation: Evladın kalacak gencecik sen yaşlanıp giderken,

lines.original: And see thy blood warm when thou feel’st it cold.
lines.english: You would see your blood warm when you feel it growing cold.
lines.translation: Isıtacak kalbini onun sıcaklığı sen git gide soğurken.
